zh: 服务器每晚自动重启。
en: The server restarts {automatically} every night.

zh: 昨晚备份没有正常运行。
en: The backup didn't run {properly|correctly} last night.

zh: 网站今天极其慢。
en: The website is {extremely|incredibly|really|very|so} slow today.

zh: 我最近把笔记本升级到了最新版本。
en: I {recently} upgraded my laptop to the latest version.

zh: 但愿这个补丁能解决登录问题。
en: {Hopefully}, the patch will fix the login issue.

zh: 从技术上讲是可行的，但要花好几个月。
en: It's {technically|theoretically} possible, but it would take months.

zh: 我重置了密码，但还是登录不了。
en: I've reset my password, but I {still} can't log in.

zh: 如果你再看到那个报错，马上给我打电话。
en: If you see that error again, call me {immediately|right away|straight away}.

zh: 我不小心删错了文件夹。
en: I {accidentally|mistakenly} deleted the wrong folder.

zh: 我们只能手动安装更新。
en: We had to install the update {manually}.

zh: 我的手机快没电了。
en: My phone is {almost|nearly} out of battery.

zh: 你可以在家远程访问服务器。
en: You can access the server {remotely} from home.

zh: 这显然是网络问题，因为谁都连不上。
en: It's {obviously|clearly} a network problem, because nobody can connect.

zh: 系统老是不停地要我改密码。
en: The system is {constantly|always|continually} asking me to change my password.

zh: 这个应用没有网络时能离线使用吗？
en: Does this app work {offline} when there's no internet?

zh: 你的数据被安全地存储在云端。
en: Your data is stored {securely|safely} in the cloud.

zh: 网站宕机了大概两个小时。
en: The site was down for {roughly|about|around|approximately} two hours.

zh: 我们没买新服务器，而是把所有东西都迁到了云上。
en: We didn't buy new servers. We moved everything to the cloud {instead}.

zh: 我以前从没用过这个软件。
en: I've {never} used this software before.

zh: 旧系统下个月将被永久关闭。
en: The old system will be switched off {permanently|for good} next month.
